Hey team — OAuth PR is up for review! PLAT#4521. Would appreciate a security review from <@U002BOB|bob-security> before we merge.

--- Reply by Bob Security (U002BOB)
Message TS: 1736847600.000200
Reactions: thumbsup (1)

On it! Will review this afternoon. Quick question: are we storing the PKCE code verifier server-side or client-side?

--- Reply by Alice Dev (U001ALICE)
Message TS: 1736849400.000300

Client-side in sessionStorage — it's generated fresh per auth attempt and deleted after exchange. Server never sees the verifier, only the code challenge (which is public anyway).

--- Reply by Bob Security (U002BOB)
Message TS: 1736851200.000400

Smart. sessionStorage is scoped to the tab/window so it can't leak across tabs. Good call.

One concern: the token refresh mutex — if the first refresh fails, do queued requests get unblocked with an error or do they retry?

--- Reply by Alice Dev (U001ALICE)
Message TS: 1736852100.000500

They get rejected with the error and the caller decides whether to retry (usually means redirect to login). We don't retry internally to avoid cascading failures.

--- Reply by Bob Security (U002BOB)
Message TS: 1736860800.000600
Reactions: rocket (3)

Perfect. That's the right pattern. Added review comments for the minor things (mostly nits). LGTM overall :white_check_mark:
